items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Al McKibbon, the bass player, was with him.

ctx.x: Dave Burns was in the trumpet section, Lammar Wright, Jr., Ike – I can’t think of his last name. There were several people who came. Elmon Wright was in the band at one time. Al McKibbon, the bass player, was with him. Who played piano? I’m trying to remember.
